Fix identified (Interval.fromISO must catch the InvalidDateTimeError thrown by DateTime.fromISO when Settings.throwOnInvalid is true, and fall back to Duration parsing). Patch is being applied and tested now.
Still localizing the src/impl/util.js bug behind the '100 barrier / February' behaviour; will patch and test once identified.

Fixed: src/interval.js `Interval.fromISO` now wraps each `DateTime.fromISO` call in try/catch and tracks start/end validity, so with `Settings.throwOnInvalid = true` it no longer throws on duration-based intervals ("2016-01-01/P1Y", "P1Y/2016-01-01") and still throws InvalidIntervalError for unparsable input. All 127 interval tests pass; no pre-existing test broken.

Fixed: `objToLocalTS` in src/impl/util.js now calls `d.setUTCFullYear(obj.year, obj.month - 1, obj.day)` so the day/month are re-normalised against the real year's leap rules (year 100 is not a leap year, 2000 is). `DateTime.fromISO("0099-12-31").plus({day: 61})` now gives 0100-03-02 instead of 0100-03-01. Full suite unchanged apart from the 2 pre-existing French-ICU toFormat failures.
